activity.notes: After the assassination of Girolamo Riario in 1488, Caterina Sforza took power in the name of her minor son Ottaviano Riario; a papal bull formally confirmed her regency that year. She continued to govern the Riario lordships of Forlì and Imola until Cesare Borgia's conquest, with the final fortress of Ravaldino falling in January 1500. ATLAS models a regency, not sovereign queenship.

sources.title: Caterina Sforza — Treccani, Dizionario Biografico degli Italiani
sources.citation_text: Treccani records Caterina taking power for her son in 1488, formal confirmation of her regency, and the fall of her remaining Forlì stronghold in January 1500.
